content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.managedDefault', "In the model picker, Org default identifies the model your organization sets for new chats. It remains on that model when you choose another model for this chat; the checkmark identifies your current selection. Auto carries the same label when it is the organization default."));

content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.detailsPage', "In the model picker, thinking effort and context appear as a configuration button on the hovered, selected, or keyboard-focused model. Use Up and Down Arrow to focus a model and Enter to select it. To open its information and configuration page without selecting it, press Right Arrow, or use Tab to reach its configuration button and press Enter or Space. The button shows Details when no readout is available. Models without configurable settings still open their information page. The thinking effort and context readout beside the model name in the chat input opens the same page for the current model. Opening the page focuses its configuration controls when available. Known values are shown even at their defaults. The Back to Models arrow is beside the model name; navigation and model actions stay at the top while details scroll. Back to Models, or {0}, returns to the previous provider, search, and model list with focus on that model. Escape closes the picker from any page and restores focus.", tabbedPickerKeys.back));

content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.optimizeFor', "Auto's details hold its \"Optimize for\" preference: Efficiency, Balance, or Intelligence, followed by HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max when available. Open them from Auto like any model's details, then use arrow keys to move between preferences and Enter or Space to choose one. Choosing a preference selects Auto and keeps its details open. When Auto has a discount, it is described below the preferences. HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max are research previews: choosing one selects it and shows its description below the preferences in place of Auto's discount, with Learn more reachable by Tab. While HydraFusion or HydraFusion Max is in use, Auto stays checked in the model list with it as its preference; choosing another preference returns to Auto. The preference readout beside Auto in the chat input opens the same details."));

+		content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.ensemble', "When Auto is presented as Ensemble, its \"Optimize for\" preferences are Balance and Intelligence, followed by Max when HydraFusion is available. Max uses HydraFusion Max, and Intelligence can use HydraFusion; choosing either keeps Ensemble checked with that preference."));

content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.resetToDefault', "In a model's details, use Tab to reach thinking effort, context, and model actions. Use arrow keys to move between options, then Enter or Space to choose one. Reset to Default appears beside Pin Model when thinking effort or context has been changed. It restores both settings to the model's defaults without changing its pinned state. Choosing an option or resetting the settings selects that model and keeps its details open. Pinning or unpinning updates the model list without moving its details or keyboard focus. Back does not undo saved settings, but a save that finishes after leaving details does not override a newer model selection."));

content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.pricingDetails', "Pricing Details expands in place without moving the model's controls. Expansion and collapse are immediate when reduced motion is enabled. If the details exceed the available space, use Page Up or Page Down while the model details have focus to scroll."));

content.push(localize('chat.modelPicker.search', "Type while the model list is focused to search across all providers. In the search field, use Up and Down Arrow to navigate results, Enter to select a model, and Escape to close the picker. Left and Right Arrow move the text cursor."));
